exact_statement: Determine how large n must be as a function of r >= 2 so that there is an antichain in 2^[n] occupying n-3 distinct ranks and containing at least r members on every occupied rank.
scope_notes: Round-two warm restart from commit ab4b524; the relaxed c>=2 theorem and c=1 normal form are inherited evidence.
Global closure requires the actual c=1 chamber exhaustion, effective completion of c>=2, and a valid passage to the public antichain threshold.
Priority target is the scale-uniform G++ inequality e>=binom(a-1,3), followed by the gamma5-negative rank-six branch.
